rca_of_issue: Original bug: 5 sites in server.py called `json.loads(raw)` directly on LLM output; any deviation (markdown fences, trailing commas, prose before JSON, empty response, malformed structure) triggered a raise that propagated up and either 500'd the API or leaked JSON parse errors into the UI. Fix: centralized helper `_parse_llm_json` with (a) strict parse, (b) regex outermost {...} extraction, (c) light repair (trailing commas, unquoted keys, single quotes) — and a sentinel dict `{parse_error: True, error_message: <italian>, parse_error_kind: <internal>, <fallback_key>: raw[:300]}` on total failure. Frontend surfaces banner instead of raw fields; internal keys hidden from KV rows.
